title: 花笠音頭 (Hanagasa Ondo — Flower Hat Dance)
description: The iconic folk dance song of Yamagata Prefecture, performed every August at the Yamagata Hanagasa Festival. Dancers wave flower-decorated sedge hats (hanagasa) in elegant circular motions while singing verses celebrating the beautiful landscapes of Yamagata, Tendo, and Obanazawa. Rooted in Taisho-era work songs used to keep rhythm during construction, it was formalized as a festival dance in the early Showa period. The 'ハァ ヤッショーマカショ' refrain is one of the most recognizable calls in Japanese folk music.
